// ------------------------------------------------------------
// COVER PAGE
// ------------------------------------------------------------
#let fmt-cover = {
  page(
    paper: "a4",
    margin: (top: 12mm, bottom: 12mm, left: ML, right: ML),
    header: none,
    footer: none,
  )[
    // Name / Class table — 2x2 bordered grid, top right corner
    #align(right + top)[
      #table(
        columns: (auto, 55mm),
        align: (left + horizon, left + horizon),
        stroke: (thickness: 0.6pt, paint: black),
        inset: (x: 2mm, y: 2mm),
        row-gutter: 0mm,
        column-gutter: 0mm,

        text(size: 12pt, font: "Times New Roman", weight: "bold")[Name:],
        text(size: 12pt, font: "Times New Roman")[ ],
        text(size: 12pt, font: "Times New Roman", weight: "bold")[Date:],
        text(size: 12pt, font: "Times New Roman")[ ]
      )
    ]

    #v(15mm)

    // Title block centered
    #align(center)[
      #text(size: 28pt, font: "Times New Roman", weight: "bold")[Final Exam Mock 1]
    ]
    #v(5mm)
    #align(center)[
      #text(size: 18pt, font: "Times New Roman", weight: "bold")[Form 1 Mathematics]
    ]
    #v(3mm)
    #align(center)[
      #text(size: 14pt, font: "Times New Roman")[Paper 1 — Question-Answer Book]
    ]
    #v(3mm)
    #align(center)[
      #text(size: 12pt, font: "Times New Roman", style: "italic")[This paper must be answered in English,]
    ]

    #v(6mm)

    #box(
      fill: rgb("#F5F5F5"),
      inset: (x: 4mm, y: 3mm),
      stroke: (thickness: 0.6pt, paint: black),
      width: 100%,
    )[
      #text(size: 11pt, font: "Times New Roman", weight: "bold")[INSTRUCTIONS]
      #v(2mm)
      #set par(justify: false)
      #set text(size: 10pt, font: "Times New Roman")
      1. Write your Name and Class in the spaces provided at the top of this page.
      #v(1mm)
      2. This paper consists of THREE sections, A(1), A(2) and B.
      #v(1mm)
      3. Attempt ALL questions in this paper. Write your answers in the spaces provided in this Question-Answer Book. Do not write in the margins.
      #v(1mm)
      4. Graph paper and supplementary answer sheets will be supplied on request. Write your Name and mark the question number box on each sheet, and fasten them with string INSIDE this book.
      #v(1mm)
      5. Unless otherwise specified, all working must be clearly shown.
      #v(1mm)
      6. Unless otherwise specified, numerical answers should be either exact or correct to 3 significant figures.
      #v(1mm)
      7. The diagrams in this paper are not necessarily drawn to scale.
    ]

    #align(center + bottom)[
      #text(size: 9pt, font: "Times New Roman", fill: rgb("#555555"))[Mr. T Yeung 2026]
    ]
  ]
}

content.text:
Per-paper customization now lives in `main.typ`. Here’s what changed:

**`main.typ`** — edit this when creating a new paper:
- Title, subject, paper type, language note
- All 7 instruction items (as a list)
- Footer credit
- Total page count

**`style.typ`** — shared formatting only:
- `fmt-cover(paper)` takes the config dict
- `make-paper(paper, exam-content)` assembles the document from config + questions

**`content.typ`** — unchanged; still holds question data.

To make a new variant, update the `paper` dict at the top of `main.typ` and swap in your questions in `content.typ`. The project compiles successfully.
